lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Five heads in a row. Tails is due.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: It has to even out. Tails, for sure.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: Next flip? Still a coin toss.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: Each flip starts fresh. The last five heads change nothing.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: Over thousands of flips it does even out. The streak gets buried, not fixed.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: Coins don't remember. Streaks just happen.
